description: Multi-document stream markers (`---`, `...`) are out of scope for Core 1.0 (Appendix A) — Lima frontmatter is always a single document, so each marker line matches no key pattern and is silently skipped like any other unrecognized top-level line (§4), not treated as a document boundary. Strict-mode parity for this general mechanism is already covered by core.document.unrecognized-line.skipped-both-modes; no separate strict case is needed here.
